[SWS_DM_01318] Realization of RequestTransferExit (0x37) in context of RequestFileTransfer
⌈
If a RequestTransferExit (0x37) in context of RequestFile-
Transfer is received, the Diagnostic Server instance shall call (depending on
the data direction read/write) the Exit method of the handler classes registered via
the template constructors of DataTransferReadSession or DataTransferWriteSession.
⌋
